Title: Create a new order with measurements and verify both English and Bengali names are displayed in the order details
Preconditions: User is logged in and has an existing customer with phone number '5551234567'. The item 'Formal Shirt' (English) / 'ফরমাল শার্ট' (Bengali) exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' screen. 2. Enter customer phone number '5551234567' and select the matching customer. 3. Select the item 'Formal Shirt' from the item list. 4. Add a measurement group for the item. 5. Enter the following measurements: Chest (ইঞ্চি) = 40, Waist (ইঞ্চি) = 34. 6. Submit the order. 7. Open the order details page for the newly created order.

Test Data: Customer: Phone = '5551234567', Name = 'John Doe'; Item: English Name = 'Formal Shirt', Bengali Name = 'ফরমাল শার্ট'; Measurements: Chest = 40, Waist = 34, Unit = 'ইঞ্চি' (inch).
Expected Result: The order details page displays the measurements with both English and Bengali names: 'Chest (বুক)' = 40 inches and 'Waist (কোমর)' = 34 inches. The item name is displayed as 'Formal Shirt (ফরমাল শার্ট)'.
